notes: On the Wausau Friday Fish Fry Guide with matching address/phone. Friday fry described as shrimp and perch. Neighborhood bar with banquet hall, pool, darts, patio. Listed hours are bar hours - confirm the fry window.

60-lane bowling center; in-house Northwoods Bar & Grill runs 'Fish Fry Fridays'. Owner is a Marathon County Tavern League board member. Species/price not published (seasonal PDF menus only). Strong sponsor prospect.
Bowling center with full bar & grill; Friday Fish Fry listed. On the Wausau Friday Fish Fry Guide with matching address/phone. Closed Sun/Mon. Species and price not published.
Also 'The B&R'. Near-north-side corner bar and grill. Known for the EURO pizza, fresh-cut fries and Krueger's Bakery buns - good description material. Get the fry window and species.

West-side tavern with outdoor volleyball, pool, darts, karaoke. Friday fry described as cod and perch baskets. Directory source only - confirm species, price, window. Not on any Lenten guide, a genuine gap.

Bar/restaurant in the clubhouse of Tribute Golf Course, a PUBLIC course - open to non-golfers. Bluegill fry is the named dish; bluegill is rare in the metro and would stand out in the fish filter. ADDRESS CONFLICT 1000 vs 1001 Golf Club Rd. PHONE BLANK - every number found was shared with the Legion post or pro shop.

Downtown pub with a 'Friday Fish Specials' menu section and a 'Poor Man's Slopster' for fish fry Fridays. Own site does not name the fry or species. Closed Mon-Tue. Hosts the separate Mumble Wrap concept in-house - ask which kitchen runs the fry.

Neighborhood breakfast/comfort-food cafe. On the Wausau Friday Fish Fry Guide; menu cites pan-fried walleye and cod. FRIDAY-SPECIFIC TIMING NOT CONFIRMED - fish may be an everyday item. Verify before publishing.

NOT A WEEKLY FRY - select Fridays only, and the dinner is CATERED BY HOEHN'S HUDDLE which is already in the guide, so it may be a duplicate kitchen. Likely members-and-guests only. Verify public access first.

Recently opened craft beer bar - the taproom category the Lenten guide misses. Food appears limited to pizza and snacks, so a traditional fry is unlikely. The one 'best fish fry' claim found is aggregator boilerplate, not a real source.

One of only four Schofield taverns and the only one besides Day Break with documented food. Menu shows pizza and fried apps including deep fried shrimp, so there is a fryer. No fry mentioned. Worth one call to close out Schofield.
Neighborhood tavern on the Schofield Ave corridor. Owner sits on the Marathon County Tavern League board so the venue is reachable. CITY AMBIGUOUS: filed under both Weston and Schofield.
Schofield neighborhood bar, #2 of 13 on Tripadvisor nightlife. Sunday Bloody Mary bar, live music, Harley events. No kitchen documented - may be drinks-only.
Small neighborhood dive with three free pool tables. No food documented. Classic no-web-presence profile - the category most likely to hide an unlisted fry.
South-side neighborhood bar, CASH ONLY. Has a kitchen - wings and a Mushroom Swiss burger - so a Friday fry is plausible. Absent from every fish fry guide checked.

HIGH-VALUE CALL. Bar & grill with a Southeast Asian menu (Beef Laab, crispy gizzards) - exactly the Hmong/Lao neighborhood-tavern category no guide has reached. If it runs a Friday fry it would be a genuinely distinctive listing.
HIGH-VALUE CALL. Hmong-owned neighborhood pub opened within about the last three years. No food menu published. NOT the same as Kluck's Callon Saloon despite the shared street name.
Classified as a bar & grill so food is served. Two blocks from Christine's on the same south-side stretch. No menu or hours found.
North-side neighborhood bar with local entertainment. No food service documented.
Established 1981, bills itself as Wausau's oldest sports bar, in a restored turn-of-the-century building - excellent description material if it runs a fry. Some listings show suite 1504.
Directory listing only - no phone, menu, hours or web presence. PHONE BLANK rather than guessed. Lowest-signal entry; included for completeness.
